name: P7 Product Check AI features — fixed text test sets for pc_fields and pc_translate (P8 eval: tools/pc-ai-eval.mjs)
source: synthetic (written 2026-11-10 before any model was run; brands, makers, numbers and lots are invented; label wording modelled on common Thai / Chinese / Korean / Japanese / English pack layouts; no real product, no person)

metrics.pc_fields: exact match after normalisation (upper case, letters + digits only) per field: product_type, brand, registration numbers (set, every expected number found), lot, expiry; plus 'invented registration' = numbers returned that are not in the text
metrics.pc_translate: line coverage = expected source lines that come back translated; preservation = every keep token (numbers, units, Latin names) appears verbatim in the translation of its line; term hit = at least one expected target-language term per line
